description: This file contains the implementation of the 'Create' feature for articles in a .NET application. It includes data models, validation rules, command handling, and database interactions for creating a new article with tags.

classes.name: Create.ArticleData
classes.description: Model representing the data for an article, including title, description, body, and tags.

classes.name: Create.ArticleDataValidator
classes.description: Validator for ArticleData ensuring non-null and non-empty values for critical fields.

classes.name: Create.Command
classes.description: Request command encapsulating the article data for creation.

classes.name: Create.CommandValidator
classes.description: Validator for the creation command, ensuring the article data is valid.

classes.name: Create.Handler
classes.description: Handles processing the create article command, interacting with the database and returning the created article envelope.

methods.name: Create.ArticleDataValidator
methods.description: Constructor configuring validation rules for article data.

methods.name: Create.CommandValidator
methods.description: Constructor configuring validation rules for the create command.

methods.name: Create.Handler.Handle
methods.description: Executes the creation process for a new article, including fetching the author, handling tags, and saving to the database.
